name: Kim's Hair Kreations
description: Kim's Hair Kreations is a cozy, boho-inspired hair studio for soft lived-in blondes, dimensional color, flattering layered cuts, and blowouts — every look a custom creation made just for you.

hero.title: Your hair, Kreated just for you.
hero.subtitle: Soft lived-in blondes, dimensional color, layered cuts, and blowouts in a cozy, boho studio — book your appointment with Kim today.

stylists.name: Kim
stylists.title: Owner & Stylist
stylists.bio: Kim is the stylist behind Kim's Hair Kreations, a cozy, boho-inspired studio where every look is a custom creation. She loves soft lived-in blondes, dimensional color, and layered cuts that grow out beautifully.

reviews.name: Ashley W.
reviews.text: Kim gave me the perfect lived-in blonde. Soft, natural, and it grows out beautifully!

reviews.name: Brooke H.
reviews.text: Her studio is so cozy and relaxing. My layers and curtain bangs came out exactly how I wanted.

reviews.name: Megan S.
reviews.text: Kim really listens and gives honest advice. My hair has never looked healthier.

reviews.name: Jordan T.
reviews.text: Such a sweet, talented stylist. Every visit feels like hanging out with a friend.
